promo-desc: Enter your email and we'll send you a code that unlocks the promo plan in the Speak2DB Excel add-in. One code per email, activated in seconds.
promo-step2: Copy the code we send you.
promo-step3: Open the Speak2DB add-in in Excel, go to My Account and paste the code.
promo-success-desc: If that address is valid, the code is on its way. It can take a couple of minutes to arrive. Didn't get it? You can request it again in 15 min.
promo-already-sent-desc: We already sent a code to this address. Check your inbox and spam, it can take a couple of minutes to arrive. You can request it again in {minutes} min.

promo-privacy: We only use your email to send this code and to contact you about the Speak2DB beta. No spam, ever.
